menu.name: Doro Wat
menu.description: A traditional Ethiopian spicy chicken stew simmered slowly with berbere, onions, and aromatic spices, usually served with a boiled egg.

menu.name: Kitfo
menu.description: A beloved Ethiopian dish of finely minced beef seasoned with mitmita and spiced clarified butter, traditionally served with ayib.

menu.name: Shiro Wat
menu.description: A comforting Ethiopian stew made from ground chickpeas, berbere, garlic, and onions, served with injera.

menu.name: Tibs
menu.description: Tender pieces of sautéed beef cooked with onions, peppers, and Ethiopian spices.

menu.name: Beyaynetu
menu.description: A colorful Ethiopian mixed platter featuring a selection of vegetarian stews served together on injera.

menu.name: Misir Wat
menu.description: A rich Ethiopian red lentil stew prepared with berbere, onions, garlic, and traditional spices.

menu.name: Gored Gored
menu.description: A traditional Ethiopian beef dish featuring cubes of beef seasoned with spicy Ethiopian condiments.

menu.name: Fasting Firfir
menu.description: A traditional Ethiopian breakfast made with torn injera mixed into a flavorful, spicy berbere sauce.

menu.name: Chechebsa
menu.description: A popular Ethiopian breakfast made from torn flatbread tossed with spiced clarified butter and berbere.

menu.name: Vegetable Couscous
menu.description: A vegetable couscous dish prepared with seasonal vegetables and aromatic spices.
